Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Validation: commands, results and their scope.

Integration impact: which engine/client capabilities change, if any.

References and reused code: update REFERENCES.bib, docs/research.md and license
notices where applicable. Link related upstream PRs.

Continuation: link the bounded work item, name the integration/review owners,
and record remaining work or live-work ownership. Update HANDOFF.md when the
next action or project state changes, and PLAN.md when the plan changes.
